Identified as this saint because: A historical panel painting, not an icon: Commons describes this 1370s altar panel at Bad Doberan Minster as 'Hannah presents her son Samuel to the temple', and files it in Category:Hannah, mother of Samuel in art. The prophetess Anna, mother of Samuel, is kept on 9 December. Commons describes it: Bad Doberan ( Mecklenburg ). Minster: Altar of Cross - Mary's side ( 1370s ): Hannah presents her son Samuel to the temple.
